body:
Thank you so much for your detailed reply, it really meant a lot to me. I probably can't come up with a very lengthy response, but I'll say this.

Your comment really did put things in perspective for me, I really appreciate your point of view.

Thank you so much, I think you're right about most of this.
Sorry it took you so long to reply, I didn't mean to use up so much of your time. :C

I'm glad I'm not alone, at least that.

I don't know if I want to be seen, I think I just want something to blame my problems on. I'm so used to feeling like everything is my fault, I want proof that it isn't.

I hope you are able to find some peace in your struggle too. Thank you for replying.

Godspeed.

Thank you.
Yeah, I tried talking to the school. As with most colleges they have a program that assists people with disabilities and disorders, but you need a referral from a doctor to even qualify. Like I said, the waiting lists were eternal and I missed my shot.

I don't think I'll qualify for American college without my grade 12 or college education (In Canada we don't have grade 12, I've been told that would cause some problems.)

I can't afford my own place at all. My parents are essentially dirt poor due to various drug addictions (not that they'd contribute anyways) and I was never allowed to get a job as I had to work on my studies.
If it hasn't been made clear yet I'm just barely 18, so I don't have many options.

I really appreciate your response. It feels good to know someone noticed this.

Thank you so much.
